subject: math
description: Compare prisms and pyramids with the same base area and height to discover why pyramid volume is one-third of the matching prism volume.
learningObjectives: Identify the base area and height of square and rectangular pyramids
Compare a prism and a pyramid that have the same base and height
Explain why three matching pyramids fill one matching prism
Use V = (1/3)Bh to find the volume of a pyramid
prerequisites: Find the area of squares and rectangles
Recognize height as the perpendicular distance from base to top
Understand that volume is measured in cubic units
